description: This is a PHP unit test class for the LocationAPI in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing the Administrative API endpoints related to Location management. It includes setup methods, data providers, and multiple test cases for CRUD operations and validation rules handling.

classes.name: LocationAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the LocationAPI REST endpoints in the OrangeHRM Admin Plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, instantiates LocationAPI, populates test fixtures, and sets up mock services.

methods.name: getTestCasesByKey
methods.description: Retrieves test cases from YAML fixture files based on a provided key.

methods.name: testGettersAndSetters
methods.description: Checks the getter and setter methods of the LocationAPI class.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test data for the getOne endpoint tests.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the getOne method to retrieve a specific location by ID.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides test data for validating getOne validation rules.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the getOne endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test data for the getAll endpoint tests.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the getAll method to retrieve list of locations.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides test data for validating getAll validation rules.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the getAll endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test data for the create endpoint tests.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new location.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Retrieves validation rules for location creation.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test data for the update endpoint tests.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing location.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Retrieves validation rules for location update.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test data for the delete endpoint tests.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of a location and the subsequent search results.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Retrieves validation rules for location deletion.
